title: NLD PACK
body:
Why you should download this pack?

-This modpack is optimized so you can play this with all your friends. There is always soemthing new too find and new too explore in this modpack. New structres, Better terrain generation, More Food, and much more!


What the modpack includes:
* 🦓|Alex Mobs ⤗ More Animals.
* 🪑|Amentments ⤗ Makes the blocks look more realistic.
* 🔨|Chipped ⤗ More Blocks variations.
* 🍅|Farmer's Delight ⤗ Adds more new Food recipes and Food items.
* 🪑|Hand Crafted ⤗ Adds various of new furnite items, Like Chairs, Benches, etc.
* 📖|Just Enough Items ⤗ Lets you view all crafting recipes in the game.
* 📦|Lootr ⤗ Lets you loot a chest, But other people can loot it too!
* 🏔|Terralith ⤗ A better Terrain generattion.
* 🗺| Xearo's Minimap + World Map ⤗ Lets you view a map of the world and put waypoints down.

This modpack is not heavy and is super optimized for best gameplay
